rosterBasis.policy: The user-provided 2026-08-23 LCP starter snapshot is the identity basis. Public profile gaps and contract-list omissions are exposed explicitly without replacing the requested player set.

semantics.contract: Only a publicly verifiable current contract expiration date is promoted to endDate. Salary, buyout, contract start, and inferred terms are excluded. Unknown expiry remains null.
semantics.career: Public team-history periods with the available date precision retained. Gaps are not silently filled.
semantics.honors: Major public team achievements and individual awards; not every minor event, weekly award, or placement.
semantics.prizeMoney: Approximate public cumulative tournament winnings in USD; not salary, bonus, buyout, or market value.
semantics.age: Completed age as of 2026-08-24, calculated from an exact public birth date.

rosterValidation.note: The public team-history table has a gap between the 2024 Rare Atom Period exit and the 2026 Ground Zero start. The gap is preserved rather than filled by inference.
The public career trail has gaps and one Bushido Wildcats period is only month-precise. No intermediate team was inferred.
